title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 024
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute dashboard and counter variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round gauge outline with side ticks and a diagonal needle across the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a full round gauge with a diagonal needle sweep.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the open arc or ring meter variants when the full dial face matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a full circular dial with side ticks and a diagonal center needle.

items.depicts_observation: Open bottom gauge arc with a centered vertical needle line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a gauge reduced to an open arc and one central needle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for full circular gauges when the bottom gap in the arc should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the lower dial edge and leaves one centered needle inside an open arc.

items.depicts_observation: Round gauge outline with top ticks and a short angled center needle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round gauge whose ticks are concentrated across the top arc.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the diagonal side tick gauge when the top tick cluster is the key cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the dial round but moves the tick emphasis to the top arc.

items.depicts_observation: Concentric round gauge with inner arc bands and a short angled center needle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round meter with nested inner arc bands around the needle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for simpler gauges when the extra inner arc bands need to remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds inner ring bands around the needle instead of a plain outer dial.

items.depicts_observation: Square counter panel with math symbols and two short number bars inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a counting or math panel instead of a gauge style meter.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dial gauges when the square panel with symbols is the visible form.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a square panel with plus cross and bar marks rather than a round gauge.
